deathlink.name: DeathLink
deathlink.description: Enables DeathLink. When jumpscared, send a death to your friends. When receiving a death, you get jumpscared.

deathlink_amnesty.name: DeathLink Amnesty
deathlink_amnesty.description: Sets how many deaths count as a death for DeathLink purposes.

show_ap_msgs.name: Display Archipelago Messages
show_ap_msgs.description: Display Archipelago messages at the top of the screen.

ap_msg_queue_time.name: Message Display Time
ap_msg_queue_time.description: Adjust how long you want Archipelago messages at the top to display for, in seconds.
